title: Separate coefficient tensor models retaining the augmentation units
statement: Fix universes d,t,u, a prime ell, a field E finite-dimensional over Q_ell, a scheme Y in universe t, and a finite-field datum D of characteristic p different from ell. On the small pro-etale site let R be the completed integral coefficient sheaf and use the recorded module sheaves and their unbounded cochain and derived categories [def-sf-integral-hom-reduction-models]. Let L denote localization, T the signed total tensor and C the product Hom complex. Fix K in D(R), K-flat resolutions q:P -> G and q':P' -> G' [def-pc-kflat-complex], and e:LG' ≅ RHom_R(K,LG). Write H=RHom_R(K,-), V(P) for the actual restricted quotient tower [def-weil-integral-reduction-tower], and gamma and gamma' for the actual augmentations [lem-weil-integral-reduction-tower-well-defined]. Put B=R[0]. There exist A,I, a coefficient tower Q whose complexes have only degrees -1 and 0 with both terms isomorphic to R, and a natural transformation iota:const(B) -> Q. Set S(Z)=L(T(C(A,I),Z)) and U(Z)=L(C(A,T(I,Z))). There are tower isomorphisms s:H(V(P)) ≅ Q followed by U and t:V(P') ≅ Q followed by S, together with apex isomorphisms s0:H(LG) ≅ U(B), t0:LG' ≅ S(B), such that H(gamma_n) followed by s_n equals s0 followed by U(iota_n), and gamma'_n followed by t_n equals t0 followed by S(iota_n), for every n. Finally, for every signed evaluation map f:T(C(A,I),B) -> C(A,T(I,B)) satisfying IsSignedHomTensor [lem-sf-two-term-free-hom-tensor-coordinate-existence], e inverse followed by t0 and L(f) equals s0. Only the coefficient-unit comparison is normalized: no Hom-tensor comparison at Q_n, its invertibility or the desired augmented comparison of V(P) and V(P') is asserted.

proof.text: Choose a K-flat representative A of K and a K-injective representative I of LG. Tensoring I with the bounded free Q_n is K-injective (a finite cone of shifts of I). The canonical Hom representative maps and K-flat computations on q give s. The localization of C(A,I) represents H(LG), and its tensors with Q_n compute its reductions; transport through e and q prime to get t. Quotient maps and canonical resolution-independent comparisons give naturality.

proof.text: Retain the coefficient unit in these constructions. At B the tensor right unitors give s0 and t0; the ordinary scalar unit x maps to 1 tensor x and naturality for B -> Q_n give the two separate augmentation equations. The signed evaluation formula at B has coefficient degree zero and sign one, so the unitors identify f with the identity on C(A,I). Test on local sections and all Hom projections, then apply the sheafification universal property, to obtain e inverse followed by t0 and L(f) equals s0. No comparison invertibility at Q_n is used.

theorem reductionTower_unit_models
    (K : completedIntegralDerivedCategory l E Y D hl)
    (P G P' G' : CochainComplex (completedIntegralModuleSheaves l E Y D hl) ℤ)
    (q : P ⟶ G) (q' : P' ⟶ G')
    (hq : CochainComplex.IsKFlatResolutionIndependentCoefficients
      (J := AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.ProEt.topology Y)
      (R := completedIntegralCommRingSheaf l E Y D hl) q)
    (hq' : CochainComplex.IsKFlatResolutionIndependentCoefficients
      (J := AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.ProEt.topology Y)
      (R := completedIntegralCommRingSheaf l E Y D hl) q')
    (e : DerivedCategory.Q.obj G' ≅
      (hom.{t, u} Y (completedIntegralCommRingSheaf l E Y D hl)).obj
        (op K, DerivedCategory.Q.obj G)) :
    let R := completedIntegralCommRingSheaf l E Y D hl
    let H := (Functor.curry.obj (hom.{t, u} Y R)).obj (op K)
    let B : CochainComplex (Modules.{t, u} Y R) ℤ :=
      (CochainComplex.singleFunctor (Modules.{t, u} Y R) 0).obj
      (show Modules.{t, u} Y R from SheafOfModules.unit
        ((sheafCompose (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.ProEt.topology Y)
          (forget₂ CommRingCat.{max u (t + 1)} RingCat.{max u (t + 1)})).obj R))
    ∃ (A I : CochainComplex (Modules.{t, u} Y R) ℤ)
      (Q : ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ CochainComplex (Modules.{t, u} Y R) ℤ),
      (∀ n : ℕ,
        (∀ k : ℤ, k ≠ -1 → k ≠ 0 → IsZero ((Q.obj (op n)).X k)) ∧
        Nonempty ((Q.obj (op n)).X (-1) ≅ (show Modules.{t, u} Y R from
          SheafOfModules.unit ((sheafCompose (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.ProEt.topology Y)
            (forget₂ CommRingCat.{max u (t + 1)} RingCat.{max u (t + 1)})).obj R))) ∧
        Nonempty ((Q.obj (op n)).X 0 ≅ (show Modules.{t, u} Y R from
          SheafOfModules.unit ((sheafCompose (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.ProEt.topology Y)
            (forget₂ CommRingCat.{max u (t + 1)} RingCat.{max u (t + 1)})).obj R)))) ∧
      let S := (totalTensor.{t, u} Y R).obj
        (homComplex.{t + 1, t, max u (t + 1), max u (t + 1)} (R := R) A I) ⋙
          DerivedCategory.Q
      let T := (totalTensor.{t, u} Y R).obj I ⋙
        (homComplexFunctor.{t + 1, t, max u (t + 1), max u (t + 1)}
          (R := R)).obj (op A) ⋙ DerivedCategory.Q
      ∃ (ι : (Functor.const ℕᵒᵖ).obj B ⟶ Q)
        (s : integralReductionTower l E Y D hl P ⋙ H ≅ Q ⋙ T)
        (t : integralReductionTower l E Y D hl P' ≅ Q ⋙ S)
        (s0 : H.obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj G) ≅ T.obj B)
        (t0 : DerivedCategory.Q.obj G' ≅ S.obj B),
        (∀ n : ℕ,
          H.map ((integralReductionTowerCone l E Y D hl q hq).π.app (op n)) ≫
              s.hom.app (op n) = s0.hom ≫ T.map (ι.app (op n))) ∧
        (∀ n : ℕ,
          (integralReductionTowerCone l E Y D hl q' hq').π.app (op n) ≫
              t.hom.app (op n) = t0.hom ≫ S.map (ι.app (op n))) ∧
        ∀ f : ((totalTensor.{t, u} Y R).obj
            (homComplex.{t + 1, t, max u (t + 1), max u (t + 1)} (R := R) A I)).obj B ⟶
            homComplex.{t + 1, t, max u (t + 1), max u (t + 1)} (R := R) A
              (((totalTensor.{t, u} Y R).obj I).obj B),
          IsSignedHomTensor.{t, u} Y R A I B f →
            e.inv ≫ t0.hom ≫ DerivedCategory.Q.map f = s0.hom
